body:
- Fixed command injection risk in shell output with `-o=shell -r`: unsafe values are now quoted and a warning is logged. Use `--security-force-never-escape-shell-output` to restore the previous unsafe behaviour (GHSA-h2cv-65fq-jgrp)
  - Fixed YAML structure being changed when assigning head comments (#2847) Thanks @rootsec1
  - Fixed `ireduce` to run per pipeline input, matching jq's `reduce` behaviour (#2869) Thanks @00200200
  - Fixed `map_values` to remove entries when the expression returns nothing (#2862) Thanks @yuefdev
  - Fixed preservation of comments on TOML inline table values (#2879) Thanks @iamhuman-cheolheelee
  - Fixed INI keys containing colons (#2886)
  - Fixed YAML line numbers after header preprocessing (#2939) Thanks @imharjot
  - Fixed an extra leading comment blank line with CRLF input (#2856) Thanks @cestercian
  - Cleaned up failed in-place edits (#2920) Thanks @Boulea7
  - Bumped dependencies
name: v4.54.2
